documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly states that their equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination and that they want workflow coordination and account reporting. They have requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements and have not yet approved a budget. The current stage is 'qualified' with verified consent and ownership by 'cedar-east'. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee, or specific vendor connector has been approved.

claims.quote: Our equipment maintenance team struggles with spreadsheet coordination.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. I understand that your equipment maintenance team is currently struggling with spreadsheet coordination, and you are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. A discovery meeting can help us better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. I will schedule a discovery session at your convenience.
questions: What specific challenges are you facing with your current spreadsheet coordination process?
Are there any specific systems or tools currently in use that you would like to integrate with Cedar Systems?
What are the key performance indicators or outcomes you expect from workflow coordination and account reporting?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the project.
The exact integration requirements and current system landscape are not yet defined.
